AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
AGENDA
August 28, 2013
07:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Use Permit No. UP-2013-04 & Design Review No. DR-2013-19 Location: 680 E. Alosta Avenue
APN: 8612-001-057
Applicant: Delta Groups Engineering Inc. forVerizon Wireless.
A request for approval of a Use Permit and Design Review approval to allow the construction and operation of a stealth, roof-mounted telecommunication facility located on an existing commercial building within the University District-Mixed Use (DU-MU) zone. The applicant has requested the item be continued to the September 25, 2013 Planning Commission meeting.
Item F-1 PC Staff Report 8-28-13
2.
Modification to Use Permit No. UP 2005-05 Location: 939 N. Vernon Avenue
Applicant: Morrison Hershfield Corporation
A request for approval of a modification to Use Permit UP 2005-05 to allow the construction and use of two new emergency generators at an existing Verizon telecommunication switching facility. This project is exempt under the California Environmental Quality Act, Section 15301(e) - Additions to existing Structures.
